author: Muse (port)
Cryptid team (original mod)
description: 140 Jokers and 22 consumables ported from Cryptid by the Cryptid team (SpectralPack), including the Epic, Exotic, Candy and Cursed rarities, the Bulwark and UltPair poker hands, and the Code and Unique consumable types. Requires the Balatro3DS fork's Tier 1 + Tier 2 mod APIs (create/destroy cards, retrigger returns, SMODS.Rarity, SMODS.PokerHand, SMODS.ConsumableType). The 14 Talisman big-number Jokers stay blocked; see README.txt.
name: Cryptid Pack
